manifest.title: Both canaries measured the VPS successfully, but all strategy windows are inadmissible
manifest.description: Technical diagnostic of the July 15 and July 18 PolyMomentum measurement-only VPS canaries, real-data condition-level causal-history validation, the forward-screen pipeline, paired-book execution-path instrumentation, and the preregistered complete-set lock candidate.

blocks.body: # Both canaries measured the VPS successfully, but all strategy windows are inadmissible

## Technical summary

Two separate measurement-only Linux captures have now produced 24 complete five-minute BTC conditions each without replacing the production binary. The July 15 segment has zero exact-replay-admissible conditions because its retained windows lack valid causal Binance history. The first July 18 replacement included the full one-hour pre-roll and passed CLOB token coverage, continuity, and latency for all 24 conditions, but five 22–26 second Binance outages intersect every rolling causal hour; seven settlement windows also intersect Chainlink gaps. It therefore also has zero admissible conditions and was rejected before conversion, terminal alignment, or scoring. The RTDS recorder has since been hardened and validated by a clean two-minute VPS smoke; a second July 18 replacement is running across 24 windows from 10:40Z through 12:40Z. **No binary-complement or complete-set score is admissible:** the immutable forward screen requires at least 100 terminal official-source-aligned conditions, and the sealed complete-set comparison requires at least 100 exact-replay trades. `primary_v6_volfloor_300` remains A-, `KEEP_REPLAY_RESEARCH`, and `LIVE_TRADING_OFF`.

## Capture isolation and service recovery worked

The July 15 canary recorded 4,107,504 frames across 24 conditions and all 48 outcome tokens. The July 18 replacement recorded another 2,878,466 frames across 24 conditions with no CLOB reconnect. After the VPS returned, the enabled paper-only engine, Telegram monitor, healthcheck timer, and soak-report timer were restarted. At 09:01:46Z the engine and monitor were active with PIDs 3013 and 3014, zero restarts, and no warning-or-higher journal entries since restart. The measurement binary remains isolated under `/opt/polymomentum/tools`.

## The first replacement failed closed; a hardened second segment is running

The bounded transient unit `polymomentum-binary-complement-block1-seg001-20260718.service` recorded 24 windows from 06:50Z through 08:50Z with the full 3,600-second causal Binance pre-roll. At 08:50:30Z its installed runner rejected the Binance tape and exited 1, preserving the 2,482,154,440-byte raw frame log. The complete session was copied intact to the dev box. The latest local audit passed CLOB coverage and continuity for all 24 conditions and returned `LATENCY_READY` with p50 9 ms, p95 17 ms, p99 48 ms, and a 50 ms replay recommendation. However, five Binance gaps of 22–26 seconds intersect every required causal hour; 12 Chainlink gaps affect seven settlement windows. Final result: 24 captured, 24 CLOB-ready, zero replay-admissible, zero groups. Conversion, terminal finalization, and all strategy scoring were intentionally skipped.

The recorder now reconnects after three seconds without a post-acquisition source tick while retaining the documented five-second heartbeat and never synthesizing observations. A two-minute VPS smoke recorded 120 Binance ticks with a one-second maximum gap and 117 Chainlink ticks with a two-second maximum gap, one connection, zero reconnects, and both provenance flags ready. Measurement binary `481dc2f2…f3cf68` and runner `be992ae9…5a12b` are installed with rollback copies. Segment 002 started at 09:34:55Z and is collecting 24 windows from 10:40Z through 12:40Z. It remains measurement-only and unscored.

## Loss selectivity—not headline win rate—is the strategy bottleneck

The retained strategy wins 79 of 102 trades and is profitable after fees, but its payoff ratio is only 0.324 and one worst loss costs roughly 3.35 average wins. The second 21-fold half loses $4.34. The frozen paired-book mechanism therefore asks a narrow prospective question: can simultaneous binary-book incoherence remove at least 30% of losses while retaining at least 90% of winners? At the baseline counts, the minimum passing count case is 72 winners and 16 losses; that implies an 81.82% win rate and a 0.7249 Wilson lower bound. This arithmetic shows the registered count gates are strong enough to address Wilson confidence if achieved. It is not a PnL forecast and does not satisfy fold-breadth, loss-burst, payoff, or tail gates.

## Paired-book execution is now measurable, not yet a strategy rule

The 40-trade tail cohort lost $16.07 at baseline. A chosen-token profit lock improved it by $2.91 but harmed three terminal winners; the fixed 30-second loss cut improved it by $7.08 but harmed two. That makes classification the binding failure: buying the opposite token may offer different executable payoff and depth, but liquidity alone cannot identify which underwater trades later recover. Calibration opportunities now preserve both tokens' exact top-of-book prices, displayed depths, and book ages. These ten fields are diagnostic only; the frozen binary-complement selector, every registered gate, production decisions, and live behavior are unchanged.

## A single-order complete-set lock is frozen for exact replay

`primary_v6_volfloor_300_complete_set_lock_v1` preserves every baseline entry rule and changes only the post-fill lifecycle. After 15 seconds, it may buy exactly the held share quantity of the opposite outcome with one taker FOK. Eligibility prices all shares at the submitted worst-ask ceiling—not signal-time VWAP—and reserves the maximum binary fee at any permitted fill price; because that fee peaks at 0.50, the fee bound uses `min(ceiling, 0.50)`. It requires at least $0.10 of terminal fee-inclusive locked profit and enough uncommitted cash for the maximum hedge cost. Both legs' capital remains locked until market close because immediate merge is not assumed. These strict pre-score corrections did not alter the candidate hash. Missing depth, stale books, partial quantity, and failed FOK attempts fail closed; a fill-reconciliation mismatch also trips the backtest breaker. The exact variant hash is `c25aa94a…c01363`. This is a preregistered replay candidate, not a forward result: the current bounded capture can diagnose execution, but the comparison wrapper requires 100 post-correction terminal conditions and keeps candidate reports sealed until the candidate reaches 100 exact-replay trades. Live preflight rejects the lifecycle until runtime parity exists.

## Each five-minute condition now receives an independent causal-data verdict

The auditor requires both CLOB outcome tokens and no receive gap above 2,000 ms during the market. It separately requires Binance coverage from one hour before open through close and Chainlink coverage from open through close; both tapes use the harness rule max(5,000 ms, three times median cadence). Only adjacent passing conditions are grouped. The code passes 480 Rust tests and both runner suites. It reproduced the July 15 exclusion sequence exactly, then independently quantified the first July 18 replacement as 24 CLOB-ready conditions, 24 Binance-gap exclusions, seven overlapping Chainlink exclusions, and zero admissible groups. Terminal finalization accepts an exact condition-ID allowlist and rejects unknown IDs, while replay consumes only fully ready groups. The installed monolithic-gate failure preserved raw data for this validated local re-audit rather than erasing the segment.

## The original gap failure mixed decision time with capture padding

The VPS audit reported a 3,082 ms maximum receive gap, but that gap occurred at 08:50:24Z—08:50:27Z, after the last market closed at 08:50:00Z. The auditor now evaluates continuity over the registered active market interval and retains the full-capture maximum only as a diagnostic. The corrected active-window maximum is still 2,154 ms at 07:43:10Z, so the 07:40Z market remains excluded under the unchanged 2,000 ms limit.

## Fifteen windows survive both independent continuity gates

Eight markets cross official Chainlink gaps above the unchanged five-second reference limit. One additional market crosses the 2,154 ms CLOB gap. The remaining 15 markets form five contiguous subsegments. This is salvage by pre-existing gate, not threshold search: no tolerance or strategy parameter changed after outcomes.

## Gate-clean does not mean exact-replay ready

The frozen replay needs continuous Binance RTDS from one full hour before each selected market through its close. The recovered tape spans 1784098172000–1784105429000 ms. Segments 001–003 (six continuity-clean conditions) fail because their required histories begin before that tape. Segments 004–005 (nine conditions) pass outer bounds but include 21,000 ms and 25,000 ms Binance outages; median cadence is 1,000 ms and the harness limit is 5,000 ms. The upgraded per-condition auditor independently reproduces this 6+9 partition and certifies zero admissible conditions and zero groups. Capture and replay preflights now enforce both the one-hour outer bound and the identical internal-gap rule before harness execution.

## Scope, data, and decision definitions

The audited unit is one recorded BTC five-minute binary condition. Binance RTDS is the causal signal/volatility source; official Chainlink RTDS is the settlement-alignment source. A gate-clean condition avoids every CLOB receive gap above 2,000 ms and every reference observation gap above the finalizer's five-second minimum limit. An exact-replay condition additionally needs a continuous causal Binance hour before its first market, with maximum gap no larger than max(5,000 ms, three times median cadence), reference coverage through final close, terminal Gamma metadata, and official-source settlement agreement.

## Methodology

The measurement binary recorded CLOB frames plus both RTDS tapes in one bounded 7,260-second session. The preserved VPS payload was copied without compression to the dev box; source tapes were hashed and checked in timestamp order. The raw CLOB capture had already converted once to three exact-replay gzip hours with zero conversion errors. The upgraded release auditor then streamed the same raw frames, evaluated CLOB, Binance, and Chainlink readiness independently for every five-minute condition, and formed groups only from adjacent all-pass conditions. Its result was reconciled against the prior manual segmentation and matched every stage exactly. The chart compares condition counts only; latency, event volume, and profitability remain in exact audit tables because they use incompatible units.

## The retained strategy is still profitable but below A+

The measured-latency strict 42-fold baseline retains 102 trades and +$13.54 after fees. It still fails the 0.70 Wilson floor, 20-profitable-report breadth, five-report loss-burst limit, and positive second-half PnL requirement. The canary has not changed any of those results.

## Limitations and robustness

The VPS is reachable again and the preserved 3,483,427,156-byte raw frame file plus authoritative Binance and Chainlink tapes were recovered. The automated condition-level re-audit matches the independent manual diagnosis, which materially raises confidence in the exclusion logic; it does not make any window admissible. Terminal labels were not refreshed or inferred because all 15 continuity-clean conditions fail signal-history admissibility, and terminal outcomes cannot repair an invalid causal tape. The sample is also far below the registered 100-condition disclosure floor. This is valid measurement-pipeline evidence, not profitability evidence.

## Next steps

1. Let the hardened segment 002 finish, then verify its exact CLOB latency, per-condition Binance/Chainlink continuity, and ownership-safe post-processing without changing any gate.
2. Preserve and audit the block exactly as segment 001, and convert/finalize only all-pass condition groups.
3. Replay the exact frozen complete-set variant only through its sealed wrapper at measured latency; reconcile all missing-leg attempts, fills, fees, locked-profit floors, and unresolved exposure against the identical-entry baseline.
4. Continue bounded segments until the binary-complement preflight has at least 100 terminal aligned conditions and the sealed complete-set candidate has at least 100 exact-replay trades. More than 100 conditions will probably be required. Keep CPU-heavy replay on the dev box.
5. Score `binary_complement_coherence_v1` and `complete_set_lock_v1` only under their separate preregistered contracts; a mechanism that passes block 1 still needs an unchanged second disjoint block at the same respective condition/trade floor.
6. Preserve `LIVE_TRADING_OFF` unless two fresh blocks and exact measured-latency replay pass the full A+ contract, live lifecycle parity is implemented, and a fresh registry audit returns `live_ready=true`.

## Further questions

- Will the three-second source watchdog prevent long RTDS gaps throughout a full three-hour collection, or will it correctly expose a true upstream outage?
- Will enough future conditions survive unchanged continuity gates to reach the 100-condition disclosure floor without changing the frozen mechanism?
- The preserved July 15 and first July 18 raw frame files remain available; when should they be retired under the runbook's ownership rule after durable diagnostics are complete?
